```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = TRUE)
library(Seurat)
library(BPCells)
library(Matrix)
library(GSVA)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(edgeR)
library(variancePartition)
library(BiocParallel)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(lmerTest)
library(conflicted)
conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter, dplyr::select, dplyr::mutate, dplyr::arrange,
  dplyr::count, dplyr::rename, dplyr::summarise, dplyr::summarize,
  dplyr::group_by, dplyr::ungroup, dplyr::n, dplyr::first, dplyr::last,
  dplyr::lag, dplyr::desc, dplyr::slice,
  base::intersect, base::setdiff, base::union, base::unname,
  base::as.data.frame, base::pmin, base::pmax, base::table, base::which,
  variancePartition::eBayes, variancePartition::topTable,
  lmerTest::lmer,
  .quiet = TRUE
)
register(MulticoreParam(16))

"%!in%" <- Negate("%in%")
tcr_bcr_re <- "^TR[ABDG][VDJC]|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC"

# 16-core parallel backend (Mac M5 Max)
bp <- MulticoreParam(workers = 16, progressbar = FALSE)

# Shared visual order + palettes (match fig5: lesion progression early -> advanced)
lesion_order   <- c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor", "Erythroderma")
lesion_colors  <- c(Patch_Plaque  = "#E69F00",
                    Tumor         = "#9F86C0",
                    Erythroderma  = "#E07A5F")
subtype_colors <- c(Subtype_1 = "#B2182B", Subtype_2 = "#2166AC", ND = "#AAAAAA")

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 11))
```

```{r load_data}
unified <- readRDS("../fig5/unified.rds")

# CTCL subtype labels from fig4 (sample id formatted "S157__CTCL")
subtype_df      <- readRDS("../fig4/results/subtype_df.rds")
orig_to_subtype <- setNames(subtype_df$subtype, sub("__CTCL$", "", subtype_df$sample))
st <- base::unname(orig_to_subtype[as.character(unified$orig.merge)])
st[is.na(st) | st %!in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")] <- "ND"   # not determined
unified$subtype <- st

# subset to CTCL samples of the 3 lesion types of interest
ctcl <- subset(unified, Dx.simple == "CTCL" & Sample.Type.simple %in% lesion_order)
ctcl$lesion_type <- factor(as.character(ctcl$Sample.Type.simple), levels = lesion_order)
ctcl$subtype     <- factor(as.character(ctcl$subtype),
                           levels = c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2", "ND"))

cat("cells:", ncol(ctcl), " samples:", length(unique(ctcl$orig.merge)), "\n")
cat("\ncells by lesion_type:\n");      print(table(ctcl$lesion_type, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\ncells by subtype:\n");          print(table(ctcl$subtype,     useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\ncells by celltype.unified:\n"); print(table(ctcl$celltype.unified, useNA = "ifany"))

n_na <- ctcl@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, subtype) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(is.na(subtype))) %>% pull(n)
cat("\nsamples with no fig4 subtype (NA):", n_na, "\n\n")

ctcl@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, subtype) %>%
  count(lesion_type, subtype) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = subtype, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% print()
```

```{r lesion_da}
MIN_SAMPLES <- 2

# propeller: logit-transformed celltype proportions + limma, with GEO.Cohort as a
# random effect via duplicateCorrelation. Patch_Plaque = reference -> coefficients
# are Tumor_vs_PP and Erythroderma_vs_PP (matches fig5 unified_da_dx_propeller).
samp_les <- ctcl@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(lesion_type = factor(as.character(lesion_type), levels = lesion_order))

props_les <- speckle::getTransformedProps(
  clusters  = as.character(ctcl$celltype.unified),
  sample    = as.character(ctcl$orig.merge),
  transform = "logit")

tp_les   <- props_les$TransformedProps                    # celltype x sample
samp_les <- samp_les[match(colnames(tp_les), samp_les$orig.merge), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(tp_les), samp_les$orig.merge))

design_les <- model.matrix(~ lesion_type, data = samp_les)  # PP = reference
dc_les  <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(tp_les, design_les, block = samp_les$GEO.Cohort)
fit_les <- limma::eBayes(limma::lmFit(tp_les, design_les, block = samp_les$GEO.Cohort,
                                      correlation = dc_les$consensus.correlation))

da_les <- bind_rows(lapply(c("lesion_typeTumor", "lesion_typeErythroderma"), function(co)
  limma::topTable(fit_les, coef = co, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("celltype") %>%
    transmute(celltype,
              contrast = paste0(sub("^lesion_type", "", co), "_vs_PP"),
              estimate = logFC, t = t, p_value = P.Value, adj_p = adj.P.Val))) %>%
  arrange(contrast, p_value)
saveRDS(da_les, "results/da_les.rds")
cat("consensus intra-cohort correlation:", round(dc_les$consensus.correlation, 3), "\n")
print(as_tibble(da_les), n = Inf)

da_les <- readRDS("results/da_les.rds")
da_les %>%
  mutate(star = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ""),
         hj   = ifelse(estimate > 0, -0.4, 1.4)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, reorder(celltype, estimate), fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star, hjust = hj), size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast) +
  labs(x = "logit-prop effect (vs Patch_Plaque)", y = NULL,
       title = "Differential abundance across lesion types (propeller)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r lesion_da_scatter}
da_wide <- da_les %>%
  select(celltype, contrast, estimate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = estimate) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tumor_vs_PP), !is.na(Erythroderma_vs_PP)) %>%
  mutate(dif = Tumor_vs_PP - Erythroderma_vs_PP)   # + = larger in Tumor, - = larger in Ery

# tight limits (data range + 8% pad) so the points fill the panel
pad  <- 0.08
xr   <- range(da_wide$Tumor_vs_PP);        xr <- xr + c(-1, 1) * diff(xr) * pad
yr   <- range(da_wide$Erythroderma_vs_PP); yr <- yr + c(-1, 1) * diff(yr) * pad
dlim <- max(abs(da_wide$dif), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(da_wide, aes(Tumor_vs_PP, Erythroderma_vs_PP)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dif), size = 3.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = celltype), color = "grey15", size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = "grey80",
    box.padding = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = base::unname(lesion_colors["Erythroderma"]),
                        mid = "grey85", high = base::unname(lesion_colors["Tumor"]),
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-dlim, dlim),
                        name = "Tumor − Ery\nlogit") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
  labs(x = "Tumor vs PP", y = "Erythroderma vs PP",
       title = "") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
ggsave("figs/ctcl.lesion.da.propeller.scatter.pdf", height = 4, width = 4.75, dpi = 600)
```

```{r lesion_bulk_deg}
# Whole-sample bulk of the CTCL-lesional TME (malignant already removed in `ctcl`).
# One dream fit with lesion_type (PP reference) -> Tumor_vs_PP and Ery_vs_PP.
f   <- factor(ctcl$orig.merge)
ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + f); colnames(ind) <- levels(f)
les_bulk_pb <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(ctcl, "counts", assay = "RNA") %*% ind)
les_bulk_pb <- les_bulk_pb[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(les_bulk_pb)), ]

les_sm <- ctcl@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, GEO.Cohort) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(les_sm) <- les_sm$orig.merge
les_sm <- les_sm[colnames(les_bulk_pb), ]
les_sm$lesion_type <- factor(as.character(les_sm$lesion_type), levels = lesion_order)

les_form <- if (n_distinct(les_sm$GEO.Cohort) >= 2) ~ lesion_type + (1 | GEO.Cohort) else ~ lesion_type
les_dge <- DGEList(les_bulk_pb, samples = les_sm)
les_dge <- calcNormFactors(les_dge[filterByExpr(les_dge, group = les_sm$lesion_type, min.count = 5, min.prop = .1), ])
les_vo  <- voomWithDreamWeights(les_dge, les_form, les_sm, BPPARAM = bp)
les_fit <- eBayes(dream(les_vo, les_form, les_sm, BPPARAM = bp))

les_bulk_tum <- topTable(les_fit, coef = "lesion_typeTumor", number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>% mutate(contrast = "Tumor_vs_PP")
les_bulk_ery <- topTable(les_fit, coef = "lesion_typeErythroderma", number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>% mutate(contrast = "Ery_vs_PP")

les_bulk_deg <- bind_rows(les_bulk_tum, les_bulk_ery)
cat("TME bulk Tumor vs PP DEGs (adj.P<0.05):", sum(les_bulk_tum$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
cat("TME bulk Ery   vs PP DEGs (adj.P<0.05):", sum(les_bulk_ery$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")

cat("\n=== top Tumor vs PP ===\n")
print(as_tibble(les_bulk_tum), n = 20)
cat("\n=== top Ery vs PP ===\n")
print(as_tibble(les_bulk_ery), n = 20)

write.csv(les_bulk_deg, "results/les_bulk_deg.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(les_bulk_deg, "results/les_bulk_deg.rds")
```

```{r lesion_bulk_scatter}
les_bulk_deg <- readRDS("results/les_bulk_deg.rds")
les_bulk_wide <- les_bulk_deg %>%
  select(gene, contrast, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast,
                     values_from = c(logFC, adj.P.Val), names_sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(logFC_Tumor_vs_PP) & !is.na(logFC_Ery_vs_PP)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    adj.P.Val_Tumor_vs_PP < 0.05 & adj.P.Val_Ery_vs_PP < 0.05 ~ "both",
    adj.P.Val_Tumor_vs_PP < 0.05                              ~ "Tumor only",
    adj.P.Val_Ery_vs_PP   < 0.05                              ~ "Ery only",
    TRUE                                                      ~ "ns"
  ))

lim <- quantile(abs(c(les_bulk_wide$logFC_Tumor_vs_PP, les_bulk_wide$logFC_Ery_vs_PP)),
                0.999, na.rm = TRUE)

# label representative genes at every extreme: Tumor axis (+/-), Ery axis (+/-),
# the shared diagonal (up/down), and the divergent anti-diagonal corners
w   <- les_bulk_wide %>%
  mutate(x = logFC_Tumor_vs_PP, y = logFC_Ery_vs_PP, s = x + y, d = x - y)
lab <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(w, x, n = 6), slice_min(w, x, n = 6),   # Tumor up / down
  slice_max(w, y, n = 6), slice_min(w, y, n = 6),   # Ery up / down
  slice_max(w, s, n = 4), slice_min(w, s, n = 4),   # shared up / down
  slice_max(w, d, n = 4), slice_min(w, d, n = 4)    # Tumor-up/Ery-down & reverse
) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(x = pmax(pmin(x, lim), -lim), y = pmax(pmin(y, lim), -lim))  # clamp to panel

# squish all points to the panel so off-scale extremes (and their labels) sit on
# the border instead of being clipped to empty space
plt <- les_bulk_wide %>%
  mutate(logFC_Tumor_vs_PP = pmax(pmin(logFC_Tumor_vs_PP, lim), -lim),
         logFC_Ery_vs_PP   = pmax(pmin(logFC_Ery_vs_PP,   lim), -lim))

ggplot(plt, aes(x = logFC_Tumor_vs_PP, y = logFC_Ery_vs_PP)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey80") +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 1, alpha = 0.4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = gene),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 10,
    min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey70",
    box.padding = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Tumor only" = base::unname(lesion_colors["Tumor"]),
                                "Ery only"   = base::unname(lesion_colors["Erythroderma"]),
                                "both"       = "black",
                                "ns"         = "grey80")) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(x = "logFC Tumor vs PP", y = "logFC Ery vs PP", color = NULL,
       title = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("figs/ctcl.lesion.bulk.scatter.pdf", height = 4.5, width = 4, dpi = 600)
```

```{r lesion_bulk_gsea}
# GSEA on the TME-only whole-sample lesion bulk DEGs, ranked by t (Hallmark + Reactome).
if (!exists("pathways")) {
  msig_tbl <- bind_rows(
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME")
  ) %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% distinct()
  pathways <- split(msig_tbl$gene_symbol, msig_tbl$gs_name)
}

run_les_gsea <- function(res) {
  rk <- res %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% { setNames(.$t, .$gene) }
  set.seed(42)
  fgsea(pathways, rk, nproc = 16) %>% as_tibble()
}

gsea_les_tum <- run_les_gsea(les_bulk_tum)
gsea_les_ery <- run_les_gsea(les_bulk_ery)

cat("Tumor vs PP GSEA hits (padj<0.05):", sum(gsea_les_tum$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Ery   vs PP GSEA hits (padj<0.05):", sum(gsea_les_ery$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

saveRDS(gsea_les_tum, "results/gsea_les_tum.rds")
saveRDS(gsea_les_ery, "results/gsea_les_ery.rds")
# collapse the leadingEdge list-column to a string so write.csv can handle it
write.csv(gsea_les_tum %>% mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")),
          "results/gsea_les_tum.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gsea_les_ery %>% mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")),
          "results/gsea_les_ery.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# plot top 7 up + 3 down Tumor vs PP pathways by padj (most significant in each direction)
top <- bind_rows(
  gsea_les_tum %>% filter(NES > 0) %>% slice_min(padj, n = 7, with_ties = FALSE),
  gsea_les_tum %>% filter(NES < 0) %>% slice_min(padj, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE)
) %>% arrange(NES) %>% mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway))

ggplot(top, aes(NES, pathway, fill = NES)) +
  geom_col() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x)
    scales::label_wrap(28)(gsub("_", " ", sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", x)))) +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL,
       title = "TME bulk Tumor vs PP (Hallmark + Reactome)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)
ggsave("figs/ctcl.lesion.bulk.gsea.tum_vs_pp.pdf", height = 5, width = 6, dpi = 600)
```

## Per-celltype pseudobulk DEG across lesion types

Per-`celltype.unified` pseudobulk DEG on the `ctcl` object across lesion types,
with `Patch_Plaque` as the shared reference (`Tumor_vs_PP`, `Ery_vs_PP`); cohort
and patient random effects where supported. Saved to `results/`.

```{r celltype_lesion_pseudobulk_deg}
# Pseudobulk: orig.merge x celltype.unified counts.
ctcl$pb_id <- paste(ctcl$orig.merge, ctcl$celltype.unified, sep = "__")
agg_les <- AggregateExpression(ctcl, assays = "RNA", group.by = "pb_id",
                               return.seurat = FALSE,
                               normalization.method = "none", verbose = FALSE)
cnt_les <- agg_les$RNA
colnames(cnt_les) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(cnt_les))

samp_les <- ctcl@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(orig.merge, lesion_type, GEO.Cohort, Patient.ID)

pb_les <- tibble(pb_id = colnames(cnt_les)) %>%
  tidyr::separate(pb_id, into = c("orig.merge", "celltype"),
                  sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(samp_les, by = "orig.merge") %>%
  mutate(lesion_type = factor(lesion_type, levels = lesion_order),
         celltype    = factor(celltype),
         GEO.Cohort  = factor(GEO.Cohort),
         Patient.ID  = factor(Patient.ID)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(pb_les) <- pb_les$pb_id

n_pb <- table(ctcl$pb_id); names(n_pb) <- gsub("-", "_", names(n_pb))
pb_les$n_cells <- as.integer(n_pb[pb_les$pb_id])
pb_les <- pb_les[!is.na(pb_les$n_cells) & pb_les$n_cells >= 10, ]
cnt_les <- cnt_les[, pb_les$pb_id, drop = FALSE]

# keep celltypes with >=3 samples in each of the 3 lesion types
keep_ct <- pb_les %>%
  count(celltype, lesion_type) %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarise(ok = n_distinct(lesion_type) == 3 && all(n >= 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(ok) %>% pull(celltype) %>% as.character()
pb_les   <- pb_les[pb_les$celltype %in% keep_ct, ]
pb_les$celltype <- droplevels(pb_les$celltype)
cnt_les  <- cnt_les[, pb_les$pb_id, drop = FALSE]

cat("celltype x lesion_type pseudobulk counts (kept):\n")
print(table(pb_les$celltype, pb_les$lesion_type))

# per-celltype dream fit, PP reference -> Tumor_vs_PP and Ery_vs_PP
fit_one_ct <- function(ct) {
  m <- pb_les[pb_les$celltype == ct, ]
  m$lesion_type <- factor(m$lesion_type, levels = lesion_order)
  dge <- DGEList(cnt_les[, rownames(m), drop = FALSE])
  dge <- dge[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(dge)), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge[filterByExpr(dge, group = m$lesion_type), ])
  use_cohort  <- n_distinct(m$GEO.Cohort) >= 2
  use_patient <- any(duplicated(m$Patient.ID))
  form <- if (use_cohort && use_patient) ~ lesion_type + (1|GEO.Cohort) + (1|Patient.ID)
          else if (use_cohort)           ~ lesion_type + (1|GEO.Cohort)
          else if (use_patient)          ~ lesion_type + (1|Patient.ID)
          else                           ~ lesion_type
  fit <- tryCatch(
    eBayes(dream(voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, m, BPPARAM = bp), form, m, BPPARAM = bp)),
    error = function(e)
      eBayes(dream(voomWithDreamWeights(dge, ~ lesion_type, m, BPPARAM = bp),
                   ~ lesion_type, m, BPPARAM = bp)))
  one <- function(coef, label)
    topTable(fit, coef = coef, number = Inf) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      mutate(celltype = ct, contrast = label, sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  bind_rows(one("lesion_typeTumor", "Tumor_vs_PP"),
            one("lesion_typeErythroderma", "Ery_vs_PP"))
}

cts <- levels(pb_les$celltype)
res_lesion_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(setNames(cts, cts), fit_one_ct))

cat("\nDEGs per celltype x contrast (FDR<0.05):\n")
res_lesion_tbl %>% filter(sig) %>% count(celltype, contrast, name = "n_sig") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig)) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

write.csv(res_lesion_tbl, "results/res_lesion_tbl.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(res_lesion_tbl, "results/res_lesion_tbl.rds")
```

```{r fibroblast_lesion_volcano}
# Volcano of the per-celltype Fibroblast Tumor vs PP pseudobulk DEGs.
res_lesion_tbl <- readRDS("results/res_lesion_tbl.rds")

v  <- res_lesion_tbl %>%
  filter(celltype == "Fibroblast", contrast == "Tumor_vs_PP") %>%
  mutate(neglog10p = -log10(adj.P.Val))
xl <- quantile(abs(v$logFC), 0.9999, na.rm = TRUE)
yl <- quantile(v$neglog10p, 0.9999, na.rm = TRUE)
v  <- mutate(v, logFC = pmax(pmin(logFC, xl), -xl), neglog10p = pmin(neglog10p, yl))

sig <- v %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)
lab <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(sig, logFC, n = 6), slice_min(sig, logFC, n = 6),
  slice_min(filter(sig, logFC > 0), adj.P.Val, n = 6),
  slice_min(filter(sig, logFC < 0), adj.P.Val, n = 6)
) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

ggplot(v, aes(logFC, neglog10p, color = logFC)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80") +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-xl, xl),
                        oob = scales::squish, guide = "none") +

    max.overlaps = 10, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey20") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xl, xl), ylim = c(0, yl), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "log2FC  (Tumor vs PP)", y = expression(-log[10]~adj.P),
       title = "Fibroblast: Tumor vs PP") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
ggsave("figs/ctcl.lesion.fibroblast.volcano.tum_vs_pp.pdf", height = 4, width = 4.8, dpi = 600)
```

```{r feature_program_defs}
# NICHE programs: literature-grounded FUNCTIONAL STATES (activation/polarization/

# TRM; Miller/Siddiqui progenitor-Tex; Plitas/De Simone tumor-Treg), B/plasma (King 2021),
# CAF taxonomy (Tuveson; Buechler 2021 universal fibro; skin papillary/reticular),
# endothelial (Goveia/Kalucka), keratinocyte states, TLS organizers.

  ## --- Macrophage ---
```

```{r niche_score_test, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
# Score each niche program in its HOME-LINEAGE pseudobulk (per sample), then test
# vs lesion_type with a cohort random effect (PP reference). Self-contained.
MIN_CELLS_N <- 10; MIN_SAMP_N <- 3; MIN_OBS_N <- 5

# --- self-containment: rebuild inputs if not already in the environment ---
if (!exists("lesion_order")) lesion_order <- c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor", "Erythroderma")
if (!exists("tcr_bcr_re"))
  tcr_bcr_re <- "^TR[ABDG][VDJC]|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC"
if (!exists("ctcl")) {
  unified <- readRDS("../fig5/unified.rds")
  ctcl <- subset(unified, Dx.simple == "CTCL" & Sample.Type.simple %in% lesion_order)
  ctcl$lesion_type <- factor(as.character(ctcl$Sample.Type.simple), levels = lesion_order)
}
if (!exists("niche_programs"))
  stop("run the `feature_program_defs` chunk first to define `niche_programs`")

cnts_n <- GetAssayData(ctcl, "counts", assay = "RNA")
cnts_n <- cnts_n[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(cnts_n)), ]
md_n   <- ctcl@meta.data
all_s  <- sort(unique(as.character(ctcl$orig.merge)))

pb_lcpm_ct <- function(ct) {
  cells <- rownames(md_n)[md_n$celltype.unified == ct]
  s <- md_n[cells, "orig.merge"]; cells <- cells[s %in% names(which(table(s) >= MIN_CELLS_N))]
  if (n_distinct(md_n[cells, "orig.merge"]) < MIN_SAMP_N) return(NULL)
  fs  <- factor(md_n[cells, "orig.merge"]); ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + fs)
  colnames(ind) <- levels(fs)
  pb  <- as.matrix(cnts_n[, cells] %*% ind)
  edgeR::cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(pb[rowSums(pb) > 0, ])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
}
score_on <- function(lcpm, genes, min_genes = 3) {
  g <- base::intersect(genes, rownames(lcpm))
  if (length(g) < min_genes) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, ncol(lcpm)), colnames(lcpm)))
  colMeans(t(scale(t(lcpm[g, , drop = FALSE]))), na.rm = TRUE)
}

# map each niche program to its HOME celltype.unified lineage (named: program -> celltype)
pn <- names(niche_programs)
niche_celltype <- setNames(dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("^Mac_",          pn) ~ "Macrophage",
  grepl("^Mono_",         pn) ~ "Monocyte",
  grepl("^DC_",           pn) ~ "mregDC",
  grepl("^cDC1",          pn) ~ "cDC1",
  grepl("^cDC2",          pn) ~ "cDC2",
  grepl("^pDC",           pn) ~ "pDC",
  grepl("^LC_",           pn) ~ "Langerhans",
  grepl("^CD8_",          pn) ~ "CD8_T",
  grepl("^CD4_",          pn) ~ "CD4_T",
  grepl("^Treg",          pn) ~ "Treg",
  grepl("^NK_",           pn) ~ "NK_Cells",
  grepl("^Bcell",         pn) ~ "B_Cells",
  grepl("^Plasma",        pn) ~ "Plasma_Cells",
  grepl("^(CAF_|Fibro_)", pn) ~ "Fibroblast",
  grepl("^Endo_",         pn) ~ "Vasc_Endo",
  grepl("^LEC_",          pn) ~ "Lymph_Endo",
  grepl("^Kerat_",        pn) ~ "Keratinocyte",
  grepl("^Mural_",        pn) ~ "Mural",
  grepl("^Melan_",        pn) ~ "Melanocyte",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
), pn)
stopifnot(!anyNA(niche_celltype))   # every program must map to a home lineage
home_cts <- unique(base::unname(niche_celltype[names(niche_programs)]))
pb_home  <- setNames(lapply(home_cts, pb_lcpm_ct), home_cts)

niche_scores <- sapply(names(niche_programs), function(p) {
  L <- pb_home[[niche_celltype[p]]]
  v <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_s)), all_s)
  if (!is.null(L)) { sc <- score_on(L, niche_programs[[p]]); v[names(sc)] <- sc }
  v
})
rownames(niche_scores) <- all_s
niche_scores <- niche_scores[, colSums(!is.na(niche_scores)) >= MIN_OBS_N, drop = FALSE]
cat("niche programs scored:", ncol(niche_scores), "/", length(niche_programs), "\n")

nmeta <- md_n %>% distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(lesion_type = factor(as.character(lesion_type), levels = lesion_order))
nmeta <- nmeta[match(rownames(niche_scores), nmeta$orig.merge), ]

niche_de <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(niche_scores), function(p) {
  d <- data.frame(score = niche_scores[, p], lesion = nmeta$lesion_type, cohort = nmeta$GEO.Cohort)
  d <- d[!is.na(d$score), ]
  if (n_distinct(d$lesion) < 2 || nrow(d) < MIN_OBS_N) return(NULL)
  fit <- tryCatch(lmerTest::lmer(score ~ lesion + (1 | cohort), d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  cf <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(fit))); cf$term <- rownames(cf)
  cf %>% filter(grepl("^lesion", term)) %>%
    transmute(program = p, celltype = base::unname(niche_celltype[p]),
              contrast = paste0(sub("^lesion", "", term), "_vs_PP"),
              estimate = Estimate, t = `t value`, p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`)
})) %>% group_by(contrast) %>% mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(contrast, p_value)
cat("niche programs FDR<0.05 by contrast:\n")
niche_de %>% filter(adj_p < 0.05) %>% count(contrast) %>% as_tibble() %>% print()
print(as_tibble(niche_de), n = Inf)

# one point per niche program: Tumor_vs_PP effect (x) vs Ery_vs_PP effect (y),
# colored by the Tumor - Ery difference (same scheme as lesion_da_scatter)
niche_wide <- niche_de %>%
  select(program, celltype, contrast, estimate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = estimate) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Tumor_vs_PP), !is.na(Erythroderma_vs_PP)) %>%
  mutate(dif = Tumor_vs_PP - Erythroderma_vs_PP)   # + = larger in Tumor, - = larger in Ery

# tight limits (data range + 8% pad) so the points fill the panel
pad  <- 0.08
xr   <- range(niche_wide$Tumor_vs_PP); xr <- xr + c(-1, 1) * diff(xr) * pad
yr   <- range(niche_wide$Erythroderma_vs_PP);   yr <- yr + c(-1, 1) * diff(yr) * pad
dlim <- max(abs(niche_wide$dif), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(niche_wide, aes(Tumor_vs_PP, Erythroderma_vs_PP)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dif), size = 3.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = paste0(program, " (", celltype, ")")),
    color = "grey15", size = 3, max.overlaps = 10, min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey80", box.padding = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = base::unname(lesion_colors["Erythroderma"]),
                        mid = "grey85", high = base::unname(lesion_colors["Tumor"]),
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-dlim, dlim),
                        name = "Tumor - Ery\neffect") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = xr, ylim = yr) +
  labs(x = "niche score effect: Tumor vs PP",
       y = "niche score effect: Ery vs PP",
       title = "Niche program lesion-type effects") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

saveRDS(niche_scores,   "results/niche_scores.rds")
saveRDS(niche_celltype, "results/niche_celltype.rds")
saveRDS(pb_home,        "results/niche_pb_home.rds")
saveRDS(nmeta,          "results/niche_meta.rds")
saveRDS(niche_de,       "results/niche_de.rds")
```

```{r niche_score_violin_pick, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4}
# violins of 3 niche scores by lesion type, side by side; each panel titled with its
# program/celltype above, split by lesion_type (lesion_order). set `picks` to any
# columns of niche_scores.
picks <- c("CD8_exhaustion", "Mac_LAM_SPP1_TREM2", "Fibro_TLS_FRC")
cat("available niche scores:\n"); print(colnames(niche_scores))
stopifnot(all(picks %in% colnames(niche_scores)))

mk_v <- function(pk) {
  d <- data.frame(score = niche_scores[, pk], orig.merge = rownames(niche_scores)) %>%
    left_join(distinct(md_n, orig.merge, lesion_type), by = "orig.merge") %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    mutate(lesion_type = factor(as.character(lesion_type), levels = lesion_order))
  ggplot(d, aes(lesion_type, score, fill = lesion_type)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = FALSE, color = NA, alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = lesion_colors, breaks = lesion_order, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "score",
         title = paste0(pk, "\n(", base::unname(niche_celltype[pk]), ")")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
plots <- lapply(picks, mk_v)
p_row <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1)
p_row
ggsave("figs/niche_violins_row.pdf", p_row, height = 4, width = 11, dpi = 600)
```

```{r niche_gene_drivers, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
# Decompose a niche program's score into its per-GENE drivers for Tumor_vs_PP.
# For the chosen program, z-score each program gene across samples (the SAME z that
# score_on averages into the program score), then test each gene vs lesion_type with
# the same cohort RE. The bar chart ranks which genes drive the program's score shift.
# Reuses pb_home / niche_programs / niche_celltype / nmeta from niche_score_test.
prog    <- "CD8_exhaustion"          # any name(niche_programs)
prog_ct <- base::unname(niche_celltype[prog])
stopifnot(prog %in% names(niche_programs), !is.null(pb_home[[prog_ct]]))

L  <- pb_home[[prog_ct]]
g  <- base::intersect(niche_programs[[prog]], rownames(L))
zz <- t(scale(t(L[g, , drop = FALSE])))                              # genes x samples, per-gene z
zz <- zz[apply(zz, 1, function(r) all(is.finite(r))), , drop = FALSE] # drop zero-variance genes
gm <- nmeta[match(colnames(zz), nmeta$orig.merge), ]

gene_de <- bind_rows(lapply(rownames(zz), function(gn) {
  d <- data.frame(z = zz[gn, ], lesion = gm$lesion_type, cohort = gm$GEO.Cohort)
  d <- d[!is.na(d$z), ]
  if (n_distinct(d$lesion) < 2) return(NULL)
  fit <- tryCatch(lmerTest::lmer(z ~ lesion + (1 | cohort), d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  cf <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(fit))); cf$term <- rownames(cf)
  cf %>% filter(grepl("^lesion", term)) %>%
    transmute(gene = gn, contrast = paste0(sub("^lesion", "", term), "_vs_PP"),
              estimate = Estimate, t = `t value`, p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`)
})) %>% group_by(contrast) %>% mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% ungroup()

tum <- gene_de %>% filter(contrast == "Tumor_vs_PP") %>% arrange(desc(estimate))
prog_eff <- if (exists("niche_de"))
  niche_de$estimate[niche_de$program == prog & niche_de$contrast == "Tumor_vs_PP"][1] else NA_real_
cat(prog, "(", prog_ct, ") — n genes scored:", nrow(tum),
    "| program-score Tumor_vs_PP effect:", round(prog_eff, 3),
    "| mean per-gene effect:", round(mean(tum$estimate), 3), "\n")
print(as_tibble(tum), n = Inf)

tum %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = gene),
         star = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ""),
         star_vjust = ifelse(estimate >= 0, -0.2, 1.2)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(gene, estimate, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star, vjust = star_vjust), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "per-gene z effect (Tumor vs Patch_Plaque)",
       title = paste0(prog, " (", prog_ct, "): per-gene z score")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(paste0("figs/niche_gene_drivers_", prog, ".pdf"), height = 4, width = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r niche_score_correlation, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
# Spearman correlation of the within-lineage niche scores across samples
# (cohort-residualized, like the integrated heatmap). niche_scores + nmeta come
# from niche_score_test.
resid_cohort <- function(x, cohort) {
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  if (sum(ok) >= 3 && n_distinct(cohort[ok]) >= 2)
    x[ok] <- residuals(lm(x[ok] ~ cohort[ok]))
  x
}
ns_res <- apply(niche_scores, 2, resid_cohort, cohort = nmeta$GEO.Cohort)
ns_cor <- cor(ns_res, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
ns_cor[is.na(ns_cor)] <- 0          # guard: pairs with no shared samples -> 0 for clustering

ann <- data.frame(celltype = base::unname(niche_celltype[colnames(ns_cor)]),
                  row.names = colnames(ns_cor))
pheatmap::pheatmap(ns_cor,
  clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - ns_cor),
  clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - ns_cor),
  annotation_row = ann["celltype"], annotation_col = ann["celltype"],
  color  = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(101),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102), fontsize = 8,
  main = "Within-lineage niche program score correlation (cohort-residualized)")
```

```{r niche_bulk_score_test, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 11}
# Score ALL niche programs on the WHOLE-SAMPLE bulk (not the home lineage), then
# test vs lesion_type with a cohort RE (PP reference). CAVEAT: bulk mixes celltype
# composition + per-cell state, so a hit here can be either; compare to the within-
# lineage niche_score_test to tell them apart.
fs_b    <- factor(ctcl$orig.merge)
ind_b   <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + fs_b); colnames(ind_b) <- levels(fs_b)
bulk_pb <- as.matrix(cnts_n[, colnames(ctcl)] %*% ind_b)   # cnts_n = TCR/BCR-filtered counts
bulk_lcpm_n <- edgeR::cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(bulk_pb[rowSums(bulk_pb) > 0, ])),
                          log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

score_bulk <- function(genes, min_genes = 3) {
  g <- base::intersect(genes, rownames(bulk_lcpm_n))
  if (length(g) < min_genes) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, ncol(bulk_lcpm_n)), colnames(bulk_lcpm_n)))
  colMeans(t(scale(t(bulk_lcpm_n[g, , drop = FALSE]))), na.rm = TRUE)
}
niche_bulk_scores <- sapply(niche_programs, score_bulk)    # samples x programs
niche_bulk_scores <- niche_bulk_scores[, colSums(!is.na(niche_bulk_scores)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
cat("niche programs scored on bulk:", ncol(niche_bulk_scores), "/", length(niche_programs), "\n")

bmeta <- ctcl@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(lesion_type = factor(as.character(lesion_type), levels = lesion_order))
bmeta <- bmeta[match(rownames(niche_bulk_scores), bmeta$orig.merge), ]

niche_bulk_de <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(niche_bulk_scores), function(p) {
  d <- data.frame(score = niche_bulk_scores[, p], lesion = bmeta$lesion_type, cohort = bmeta$GEO.Cohort)
  d <- d[!is.na(d$score), ]
  if (n_distinct(d$lesion) < 2) return(NULL)
  fit <- tryCatch(lmerTest::lmer(score ~ lesion + (1 | cohort), d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  cf <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(fit))); cf$term <- rownames(cf)
  cf %>% filter(grepl("^lesion", term)) %>%
    transmute(program = p, celltype = base::unname(niche_celltype[p]),
              contrast = paste0(sub("^lesion", "", term), "_vs_PP"),
              estimate = Estimate, t = `t value`, p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`)
})) %>% group_by(contrast) %>% mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(contrast, p_value)
cat("bulk niche programs FDR<0.05 by contrast:\n")
niche_bulk_de %>% filter(adj_p < 0.05) %>% count(contrast) %>% as_tibble() %>% print()
cat("\ntop up/down per contrast:\n")
niche_bulk_de %>% group_by(contrast) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(slice_max(.x, estimate, n = 6), slice_min(.x, estimate, n = 6))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

ord_b <- niche_bulk_de %>% filter(contrast == "Tumor_vs_PP") %>% arrange(estimate) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(program, " (", celltype, ")")) %>% pull(label)
niche_bulk_de %>%
  mutate(label = factor(paste0(program, " (", celltype, ")"), levels = ord_b),
         star  = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", "")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, label, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast) +
  labs(x = "niche score effect (vs Patch_Plaque)", y = NULL,
       title = "Niche program scores (WHOLE-SAMPLE bulk): lesion-type differential test") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 7)
```

```{r feature_correlation_lesion, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 10}
MIN_CELLS_F <- 10; MIN_SAMP_F <- 8; MIN_OBS_F <- 15

cnts_f <- GetAssayData(ctcl, "counts", assay = "RNA")
cnts_f <- cnts_f[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(cnts_f)), ]
md_f   <- ctcl@meta.data

pb_lcpm <- function(cells) {           # pseudobulk -> logCPM (all genes, no HVG filter)
  fs  <- factor(md_f[cells, "orig.merge"])
  ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + fs); colnames(ind) <- levels(fs)
  pb  <- as.matrix(cnts_f[, cells] %*% ind)
  edgeR::cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(pb[rowSums(pb) > 0, ])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
}
score_on <- function(lcpm, genes, min_genes = 3) {   # mean per-gene z across samples
  g <- base::intersect(genes, rownames(lcpm))
  if (length(g) < min_genes) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, ncol(lcpm)), colnames(lcpm)))
  colMeans(t(scale(t(lcpm[g, , drop = FALSE]))), na.rm = TRUE)
}

all_samp <- sort(unique(as.character(ctcl$orig.merge)))

# (1) COMPOSITION: per-sample CLR of celltype proportions
comp <- md_f %>% count(orig.merge, celltype.unified) %>%
  tidyr::complete(orig.merge, celltype.unified, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(orig.merge) %>% mutate(clr = log(n + 0.5) - mean(log(n + 0.5))) %>% ungroup()
comp_mat <- comp %>% select(orig.merge, celltype.unified, clr) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = celltype.unified, values_from = clr) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("orig.merge"); comp_mat <- comp_mat[all_samp, ]

# celltypes with enough cells/samples to pseudobulk
ct_keep <- md_f %>% count(celltype.unified, orig.merge) %>% filter(n >= MIN_CELLS_F) %>%
  count(celltype.unified) %>% filter(n >= MIN_SAMP_F) %>% pull(celltype.unified) %>% as.character()
pb_ct      <- setNames(lapply(ct_keep, function(ct) {
  cells <- rownames(md_f)[md_f$celltype.unified == ct]
  s <- md_f[cells, "orig.merge"]; cells <- cells[s %in% names(which(table(s) >= MIN_CELLS_F))]
  pb_lcpm(cells)
}), ct_keep)
bulk_lcpm  <- pb_lcpm(colnames(ctcl))    # (2) whole-sample bulk for global programs

# assemble the per-sample feature matrix (all numeric); track gene support
feat <- list(); det <- c(); defn <- c()
for (cn in colnames(comp_mat)) { fn <- paste0("comp:", cn)
  feat[[fn]] <- comp_mat[all_samp, cn]; det[fn] <- NA; defn[fn] <- NA }
for (p in names(global_programs)) { fn <- paste0("global:", p)
  feat[[fn]] <- score_on(bulk_lcpm, global_programs[[p]])[all_samp]
  det[fn]  <- length(base::intersect(global_programs[[p]], rownames(bulk_lcpm)))
  defn[fn] <- length(global_programs[[p]]) }
skipped <- character(0)
for (p in names(niche_programs)) {        # (3) niche programs in their home lineage
  ct <- niche_celltype[p]
  if (!ct %in% names(pb_ct)) { skipped <- c(skipped, paste0(p, "@", ct)); next }
  fn <- paste0("niche:", p, "@", ct)
  v  <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(all_samp)), all_samp)
  sc <- score_on(pb_ct[[ct]], niche_programs[[p]]); v[names(sc)] <- sc
  feat[[fn]] <- v
  det[fn]  <- length(base::intersect(niche_programs[[p]], rownames(pb_ct[[ct]])))
  defn[fn] <- length(niche_programs[[p]]) }
F <- do.call(cbind, feat); rownames(F) <- all_samp
F <- F[, colSums(!is.na(F)) >= MIN_OBS_F & apply(F, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]
cat("features:", ncol(F), " (",
    sum(grepl("^comp:", colnames(F))), "comp /",
    sum(grepl("^global:", colnames(F))), "global /",
    sum(grepl("^niche:", colnames(F))), "niche )  samples:", nrow(F), "\n")
if (length(skipped)) cat("niche programs SKIPPED (home lineage too sparse):",
                         paste(skipped, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# per-feature support: non-NA samples + genes detected/defined (for program features)
support <- tibble::tibble(
  feature = colnames(F), class = sub(":.*", "", colnames(F)),
  n_obs = colSums(!is.na(F)),
  genes_detected = det[colnames(F)], genes_defined = defn[colnames(F)]) %>%
  arrange(class, n_obs)
cat("\nper-feature support (watch low n_obs / few genes_detected):\n")
print(as_tibble(support), n = Inf)

# (4) lesion-type differential test per feature (PP reference, cohort RE)
fmeta <- md_f %>% distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(lesion_type = factor(as.character(lesion_type), levels = lesion_order))
fmeta <- fmeta[match(rownames(F), fmeta$orig.merge), ]
feat_de <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(F), function(fn) {
  d <- data.frame(value = F[, fn], lesion = fmeta$lesion_type, cohort = fmeta$GEO.Cohort)
  d <- d[!is.na(d$value), ]
  if (n_distinct(d$lesion) < 2 || nrow(d) < MIN_OBS_F) return(NULL)
  fit <- tryCatch(lmerTest::lmer(value ~ lesion + (1 | cohort), d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  cf <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(fit))); cf$term <- rownames(cf)
  cf %>% filter(grepl("^lesion", term)) %>%
    transmute(feature = fn, contrast = paste0(sub("^lesion", "", term), "_vs_PP"),
              estimate = Estimate, t = `t value`, p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`)
})) %>% group_by(contrast) %>% mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(contrast, p_value)
cat("features FDR<0.05 by contrast:\n")
feat_de %>% filter(adj_p < 0.05) %>% count(contrast) %>% as_tibble() %>% print()
print(as_tibble(feat_de), n = Inf)

# (PLOT 1) feature x feature Spearman correlation pheatmap. Correlate COHORT-
# RESIDUALIZED features so the structure reflects within-cohort biology, not batch
# (cohort = dominant variance driver). Lesion test above stays on raw F + (1|cohort).
resid_cohort <- function(x, cohort) {
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  if (sum(ok) >= 3 && n_distinct(cohort[ok]) >= 2)
    x[ok] <- residuals(lm(x[ok] ~ cohort[ok]))
  x
}
F_res   <- apply(F, 2, resid_cohort, cohort = fmeta$GEO.Cohort)
cor_mat <- cor(F_res, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
tum_eff <- feat_de %>% filter(contrast == "Tumor_vs_PP") %>%
  select(feature, estimate) %>% tibble::deframe()
ann <- data.frame(class       = sub(":.*", "", colnames(F)),
                  Tumor_vs_PP = tum_eff[colnames(F)],
                  row.names   = colnames(F))
pheatmap::pheatmap(cor_mat,
  clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - cor_mat),
  clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - cor_mat),
  annotation_row = ann["class"], annotation_col = ann[c("class", "Tumor_vs_PP")],
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(101),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102), fontsize = 6,
  main = "Feature-feature Spearman, cohort-residualized (composition + global + niche)")

# (PLOT 2) which features move across lesion types (estimate, * = FDR<0.05)
feat_de %>%
  mutate(class = sub(":.*", "", feature),
         star  = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ""),
         feature = factor(feature, levels = feat_de %>% filter(contrast == "Tumor_vs_PP") %>%
                          arrange(estimate) %>% pull(feature))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, feature, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(class ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "lesion effect (vs Patch_Plaque)", y = NULL,
       title = "Integrated features differential across lesion types") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)
```

```{r niche_gene_t_violin}
# For a given niche program x celltype: violin of per-GENE t-statistics (one point
# per program gene) from the OLD per-celltype lesion pseudobulk DEG, split by
# lesion contrast. Shows whether the program's genes are coordinately up/down in

names(niche_programs)

prog_ct <- "Fibroblast"               # its home lineage (niche_celltype[prog])

  filter(celltype == prog_ct, gene %in% niche_programs[[prog]]) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Tumor_vs_PP", "Ery_vs_PP")))

cat(prog, "in", prog_ct, "- genes found per contrast:\n")
```

```{r subtype_da}
# propeller DA across subtypes (Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2), Subtype_2 = reference.
# Same engine as lesion_da: logit props + limma + GEO.Cohort via duplicateCorrelation.
keep_sub <- ctcl$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")

samp_sub <- ctcl@meta.data %>%
  filter(subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")) %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, subtype, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1")))  # S2 = ref

props_sub <- speckle::getTransformedProps(
  clusters  = as.character(ctcl$celltype.unified)[keep_sub],
  sample    = as.character(ctcl$orig.merge)[keep_sub],
  transform = "logit")

tp_sub   <- props_sub$TransformedProps
samp_sub <- samp_sub[match(colnames(tp_sub), samp_sub$orig.merge), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(tp_sub), samp_sub$orig.merge))

design_sub <- model.matrix(~ subtype, data = samp_sub)   # Subtype_2 = reference
dc_sub  <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(tp_sub, design_sub, block = samp_sub$GEO.Cohort)
fit_sub <- limma::eBayes(limma::lmFit(tp_sub, design_sub, block = samp_sub$GEO.Cohort,
                                      correlation = dc_sub$consensus.correlation))

da_sub <- limma::topTable(fit_sub, coef = "subtypeSubtype_1", number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("celltype") %>%
  transmute(celltype, estimate = logFC, t = t, p_value = P.Value, adj_p = adj.P.Val) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

cat("consensus intra-cohort correlation:", round(dc_sub$consensus.correlation, 3), "\n")
cat("(+) estimate = higher in Subtype_1, (-) = higher in Subtype_2\n")
print(as_tibble(da_sub), n = Inf)

da_sub %>%
  mutate(star = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ""),
         hj   = ifelse(estimate > 0, -0.4, 1.4)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, reorder(celltype, estimate), fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star, hjust = hj), size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "logit prop Sub. 1 vs Sub. 2", y = NULL,
       title = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 13))
ggsave("figs/subtype_da.pdf", height = 5, width = 4.5, dpi = 600)

write.csv(da_sub, "results/da_sub.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(da_sub, "results/da_sub.rds")
```

```{r subtype_bulk_deg, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 5}
# whole-sample bulk DEG: Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2 (S2 reference), cohort RE.
keep_sub  <- ctcl$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")
cells_sub <- colnames(ctcl)[keep_sub]
f   <- factor(ctcl$orig.merge[keep_sub])
ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + f); colnames(ind) <- levels(f)
sub_bulk_pb <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(ctcl, "counts", assay = "RNA")[, cells_sub] %*% ind)
sub_bulk_pb <- sub_bulk_pb[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(sub_bulk_pb)), ]

sub_sm <- ctcl@meta.data %>% filter(subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")) %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, subtype, GEO.Cohort) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(sub_sm) <- sub_sm$orig.merge
sub_sm <- sub_sm[colnames(sub_bulk_pb), ]
sub_sm$subtype <- factor(as.character(sub_sm$subtype), levels = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1"))  # S2 = ref

form    <- if (n_distinct(sub_sm$GEO.Cohort) >= 2) ~ subtype + (1 | GEO.Cohort) else ~ subtype
dge_sub <- DGEList(sub_bulk_pb, samples = sub_sm)
dge_sub <- calcNormFactors(dge_sub[filterByExpr(dge_sub, group = sub_sm$subtype, min.count = 5, min.prop = .1), ])
vo_sub  <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge_sub, form, sub_sm, BPPARAM = bp)
fit_sub <- eBayes(dream(vo_sub, form, sub_sm, BPPARAM = bp))
res_sub_bulk <- topTable(fit_sub, coef = "subtypeSubtype_1", number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")
cat("Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2 bulk DEGs (adj.P<0.05):", sum(res_sub_bulk$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
cat("(+) logFC = up in Subtype_1, (-) = up in Subtype_2\n")
print(as_tibble(res_sub_bulk), n = 20)

res_sub_bulk <- readRDS("results/res_sub_bulk.rds")
# volcano with top up/down labeled (top 6 by logFC + top 6 by adj.P each direction)
xl <- quantile(abs(res_sub_bulk$logFC), 0.9995, na.rm = TRUE)
yl <- quantile(-log10(res_sub_bulk$adj.P.Val), 0.9995, na.rm = TRUE)
v   <- res_sub_bulk %>%
  mutate(logFC_s = pmax(pmin(logFC, xl), -xl), nlp_s = pmin(-log10(adj.P.Val), yl))
sig <- filter(v, adj.P.Val < 0.05)
#tme_rec <- c("CSF2RA", "XCR1", "IFNGR1", "CXCR5", "CXCR3", "HAVCR2")
lab <- bind_rows(slice_max(sig, logFC, n = 6), slice_min(sig, logFC, n = 6),
                 slice_min(filter(sig, logFC > 0), adj.P.Val, n = 6),
                 slice_min(filter(sig, logFC < 0), adj.P.Val, n = 6)) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

ggplot(v, aes(logFC_s, nlp_s, color = logFC_s)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80") +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-xl, xl), oob = scales::squish, guide = "none") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(logFC_s, nlp_s, label = gene), color = "black",
    size = 4, max.overlaps = 20, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey70") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xl, xl), ylim = c(0, yl)) +
  labs(x = "log2FC  (Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2)", y = expression(-log[10]~adj.P),
       title = "Whole-sample bulk: Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2") +

ggsave("figs/subtype_bulk_volcano.pdf", height = 5, width = 5, dpi = 600)

saveRDS(res_sub_bulk, "results/res_sub_bulk.rds")
```

```{r subtype_celltype_deg, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
# per-celltype pseudobulk DEG, Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2 (S2 reference), cohort RE.
MIN_SAMP_S <- 2; MIN_CELLS_S <- 10
keep_sub   <- ctcl$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")
ctcl$pb_id <- paste(ctcl$orig.merge, ctcl$celltype.unified, sep = "__")
cells_sub  <- colnames(ctcl)[keep_sub]

f   <- factor(ctcl$pb_id[keep_sub])
ind <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + f); colnames(ind) <- levels(f)
agg <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(ctcl, "counts", assay = "RNA")[, cells_sub] %*% ind)
agg <- agg[!grepl(tcr_bcr_re, rownames(agg)), ]

pb_meta_s <- ctcl@meta.data[keep_sub, ] %>%
  distinct(pb_id, orig.merge, celltype.unified, subtype, GEO.Cohort) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(pb_meta_s) <- pb_meta_s$pb_id
pb_meta_s$ncell   <- as.integer(table(f)[pb_meta_s$pb_id])
pb_meta_s <- pb_meta_s[colnames(agg), ]
pb_meta_s$subtype <- factor(as.character(pb_meta_s$subtype), levels = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1"))

run_ct_sub <- function(ct) {
  m <- pb_meta_s %>% filter(celltype.unified == ct, ncell >= MIN_CELLS_S)
  if (any(table(m$subtype) < MIN_SAMP_S)) return(NULL)
  form <- if (n_distinct(m$GEO.Cohort) >= 2) ~ subtype + (1 | GEO.Cohort) else ~ subtype
  dge  <- DGEList(agg[, m$pb_id], samples = m)
  dge  <- calcNormFactors(dge[filterByExpr(dge, group = m$subtype), ])
  vo   <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, m, BPPARAM = bp)
  fit  <- eBayes(dream(vo, form, m, BPPARAM = bp))
  topTable(fit, coef = "subtypeSubtype_1", number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>% mutate(celltype = ct)
}
cts <- sort(unique(pb_meta_s$celltype.unified))
res_subtype_ct <- bind_rows(lapply(cts, function(ct)
  tryCatch(run_ct_sub(ct), error = function(e) { message(ct, ": ", e$message); NULL })))

res_subtype_ct <- readRDS("results/subtype_celltype_deg.rds")

cat("sig DEGs (FDR<0.05) per celltype:\n")
res_subtype_ct %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% count(celltype, name = "n_deg") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_deg)) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

res_subtype_ct %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(dir = ifelse(logFC > 0, "up in Subtype_1", "up in Subtype_2")) %>%
  count(celltype, dir) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, reorder(celltype, n), fill = dir)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`up in Subtype_1` = base::unname(subtype_colors["Subtype_1"]),
                               `up in Subtype_2` = base::unname(subtype_colors["Subtype_2"])), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "sig DEGs (FDR<0.05)", y = NULL,
       title = "Per-celltype DEGs: Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r subtype_niche_score_test, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 7}
# Test the within-lineage niche scores (niche_scores from niche_score_test) vs
# subtype (Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2, S2 reference), cohort RE.
smeta <- ctcl@meta.data %>% filter(subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")) %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, subtype, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1")))
ns_sub <- niche_scores[rownames(niche_scores) %in% smeta$orig.merge, , drop = FALSE]
smeta  <- smeta[match(rownames(ns_sub), smeta$orig.merge), ]

niche_sub_de <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(ns_sub), function(p) {
  d <- data.frame(score = ns_sub[, p], subtype = smeta$subtype, cohort = smeta$GEO.Cohort)
  d <- d[!is.na(d$score), ]
  if (n_distinct(d$subtype) < 2 || any(table(d$subtype) < 3)) return(NULL)
  fit <- tryCatch(lmerTest::lmer(score ~ subtype + (1 | cohort), d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  cf <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(fit))); cf$term <- rownames(cf)
  cf %>% filter(grepl("^subtype", term)) %>%
    transmute(program = p, celltype = base::unname(niche_celltype[p]),
              estimate = Estimate, t = `t value`, p_value = `Pr(>|t|)`)
})) %>% mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
cat("niche programs FDR<0.05 (subtype):", sum(niche_sub_de$adj_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
print(as_tibble(niche_sub_de), n = Inf)

niche_sub_de %>%
  mutate(star  = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ""),
         label = paste0(program, " (", celltype, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, reorder(label, estimate), fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "niche score effect (Subtype_1 vs Subtype_2)", y = NULL,
       title = "Niche program scores: subtype differential test") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8)
```

```{r joint_da, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
# propeller DA with BOTH covariates: ~ lesion_type + subtype -> each effect is
# MUTUALLY ADJUSTED for the other (PP & Subtype_2 are the references).
keep_j <- ctcl$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")
samp_j <- ctcl@meta.data %>% filter(subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")) %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, lesion_type, subtype, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  mutate(lesion_type = factor(as.character(lesion_type), levels = lesion_order),
         subtype     = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1")))

props_j <- speckle::getTransformedProps(
  clusters = as.character(ctcl$celltype.unified)[keep_j],
  sample   = as.character(ctcl$orig.merge)[keep_j], transform = "logit")
tp_j   <- props_j$TransformedProps
samp_j <- samp_j[match(colnames(tp_j), samp_j$orig.merge), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(tp_j), samp_j$orig.merge))

design_j <- model.matrix(~ lesion_type + subtype, data = samp_j)   # PP ref, S2 ref
dc_j  <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(tp_j, design_j, block = samp_j$GEO.Cohort)
fit_j <- limma::eBayes(limma::lmFit(tp_j, design_j, block = samp_j$GEO.Cohort,
                                    correlation = dc_j$consensus.correlation))

eff_map <- c(lesion_typeTumor = "Tumor_vs_PP", lesion_typeErythroderma = "Ery_vs_PP",
             subtypeSubtype_1 = "S1_vs_S2")
da_j <- bind_rows(lapply(names(eff_map), function(co) {
  if (!co %in% colnames(design_j)) return(NULL)
  limma::topTable(fit_j, coef = co, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("celltype") %>%
    transmute(celltype, effect = eff_map[co], estimate = logFC, t = t,
              p_value = P.Value, adj_p = adj.P.Val)
}))
cat("MUTUALLY ADJUSTED DA (lesion + subtype together):\n")
print(as_tibble(da_j %>% arrange(effect, p_value)), n = Inf)

ord_ct <- da_j %>% filter(effect == "S1_vs_S2") %>% arrange(estimate) %>% pull(celltype)
da_j %>%
  mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = ord_ct),
         star = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "~", ""))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, celltype, fill = estimate)) +

  facet_wrap(~ effect) +

       title = "Joint DA: lesion + subtype mutually adjusted (* FDR<0.05, ~ p<0.05)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)
```

```{r stratified_da, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
# subtype effect WITHIN each lesion type, and lesion effect WITHIN each subtype.
# If a shift holds within a single stratum, it's not just the confound.
prop_contrast <- function(cells, grp_col, grp_levels) {
  md  <- ctcl@meta.data[cells, ]
  pr  <- speckle::getTransformedProps(clusters = as.character(md$celltype.unified),
                                      sample = as.character(md$orig.merge), transform = "logit")
  tpm <- pr$TransformedProps
  sm  <- md %>% distinct(orig.merge, .keep_all = TRUE)
  sm  <- sm[match(colnames(tpm), sm$orig.merge), ]
  grp <- factor(as.character(sm[[grp_col]]), levels = grp_levels)
  if (any(table(grp) < 3)) return(NULL)
  design <- model.matrix(~ grp)
  fit <- tryCatch({
    if (n_distinct(sm$GEO.Cohort) >= 2) {
      dc <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(tpm, design, block = sm$GEO.Cohort)
      limma::lmFit(tpm, design, block = sm$GEO.Cohort, correlation = dc$consensus.correlation)
    } else limma::lmFit(tpm, design)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)
  limma::topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("celltype") %>%
    transmute(celltype, estimate = logFC, t = t, p_value = P.Value, adj_p = adj.P.Val)
}

strat <- list(
  `S1_vs_S2 | PP`    = list(m = ctcl$lesion_type == "Patch_Plaque" & ctcl$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2"),
                            col = "subtype", lev = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1")),
  `S1_vs_S2 | Tumor` = list(m = ctcl$lesion_type == "Tumor" & ctcl$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2"),
                            col = "subtype", lev = c("Subtype_2", "Subtype_1")),
  `Tumor_vs_PP | S1` = list(m = ctcl$subtype == "Subtype_1" & ctcl$lesion_type %in% c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor"),
                            col = "lesion_type", lev = c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor")),
  `Tumor_vs_PP | S2` = list(m = ctcl$subtype == "Subtype_2" & ctcl$lesion_type %in% c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor"),
                            col = "lesion_type", lev = c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor")))
strat_da <- bind_rows(lapply(names(strat), function(nm) {
  s <- strat[[nm]]; r <- prop_contrast(colnames(ctcl)[s$m], s$col, s$lev)
  if (is.null(r)) { message("stratum skipped (too few samples): ", nm); return(NULL) }
  r %>% mutate(stratum = nm)
}))
cat("stratified DA (full):\n"); print(as_tibble(strat_da %>% arrange(stratum, p_value)), n = Inf)

# focus on the two confounded hits
strat_da %>% filter(celltype %in% c("B_Cells", "cDC1")) %>%
  mutate(star = ifelse(adj_p < 0.05, "*", ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "~", ""))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(estimate, stratum, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey90", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype) +
  labs(x = "logit-prop effect within stratum", y = NULL,
       title = "Stratified DA: B_Cells & cDC1 (* FDR<0.05, ~ p<0.05)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)
```

# Malignant - TME integration (subtype)

```{r malignant_tme_pathway, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}
# Malignant subtype DEG (fig4) vs whole-sample TME subtype DEG (res_sub_bulk):
# which pathways are coordinately enriched in BOTH compartments per subtype?
# res_skin_subtypes: + logFC = up in Subtype_1, - = up in Subtype_2.
res_malig <- readRDS("../fig4/results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")
if (!"gene" %in% colnames(res_malig))
  res_malig <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(res_malig), "gene")

if (!exists("pathways")) {
  msig_tbl <- bind_rows(
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H"),
    msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME")
  ) %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% distinct()
  pathways <- split(msig_tbl$gene_symbol, msig_tbl$gs_name)
}
gsea_rank <- function(res) { set.seed(42)
  fgsea(pathways, res %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% { setNames(.$t, .$gene) }, nproc = 16) %>% as_tibble() }

gsea_malig <- gsea_rank(res_malig)      # + NES = up in Subtype_1
gsea_tme   <- gsea_rank(res_sub_bulk)   # + NES = up in Subtype_1 (coef subtypeSubtype_1)

pw <- inner_join(gsea_malig %>% select(pathway, nes_mal = NES, p_mal = padj),
                 gsea_tme   %>% select(pathway, nes_tme = NES, p_tme = padj), by = "pathway") %>%
  mutate(both_sig = p_mal < 0.1 & p_tme < 0.1,
         concordant = sign(nes_mal) == sign(nes_tme))
rpw <- cor(pw$nes_mal, pw$nes_tme, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
lim <- max(abs(c(pw$nes_mal, pw$nes_tme)), na.rm = TRUE)
lab <- pw %>% filter(both_sig & concordant) %>%
  mutate(score = abs(nes_mal) + abs(nes_tme)) %>% slice_max(score, n = 14)

ggplot(pw, aes(nes_mal, nes_tme)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(color = both_sig & concordant), size = 1.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab,
    aes(label = scales::label_wrap(28)(gsub("_", " ", sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", pathway)))),
    size = 2.4, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = "grey75") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "grey70"),
                     name = "shared (both padj<0.1, same dir)") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("rho = %.2f", rpw),
           hjust = -0.15, vjust = 1.5, size = 4) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(x = "malignant NES (S1 vs S2)", y = "TME bulk NES (S1 vs S2)",
       title = "Shared malignant<->TME pathways by subtype") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r malignant_tme_lr, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
# Concordant ligand(malignant) -> receptor(TME celltype) pairs by subtype.
# Curated canonical TME L-R panel (literature; swap in liana/CellChatDB if installed).
lr_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ligand,   ~receptor,
  "CCL2","CCR2", "CCL3","CCR1", "CCL4","CCR5", "CCL5","CCR5", "CCL5","CCR1", "CCL5","CCR4",
  "CCL17","CCR4", "CCL22","CCR4", "CCL19","CCR7", "CCL21","CCR7", "CCL20","CCR6",
  "CXCL9","CXCR3", "CXCL10","CXCR3", "CXCL11","CXCR3", "CXCL12","CXCR4", "CXCL13","CXCR5",
  "XCL1","XCR1", "XCL2","XCR1", "CX3CL1","CX3CR1",
  "IFNG","IFNGR1", "IL2","IL2RA", "IL4","IL4R", "IL13","IL13RA1", "IL13","IL4R", "IL10","IL10RA",
  "IL15","IL15RA", "IL6","IL6R", "IL1B","IL1R1", "TNF","TNFRSF1B", "TGFB1","TGFBR2",
  "CSF1","CSF1R", "CSF2","CSF2RA", "FLT3LG","FLT3", "KITLG","KIT", "TNFSF13B","TNFRSF13B",
  "CD274","PDCD1", "PDCD1LG2","PDCD1", "CD80","CTLA4", "CD86","CTLA4", "CD86","CD28",
  "CD200","CD200R1", "LGALS9","HAVCR2", "TNFSF9","TNFRSF9", "TNFSF4","TNFRSF4",
  "CD40LG","CD40", "ICOSLG","ICOS", "TNFSF14","TNFRSF14", "NECTIN2","TIGIT", "PVR","TIGIT",
  "SPP1","CD44", "SPP1","ITGAV", "VEGFA","FLT1", "VEGFA","KDR", "MIF","CD74")

mal_l <- res_malig      %>% transmute(ligand = gene,   lfc_L = logFC, p_L = adj.P.Val)
tme_r <- res_subtype_ct %>% transmute(receptor = gene, celltype, lfc_R = logFC, p_R = adj.P.Val)

lr_tab <- lr_pairs %>%
  inner_join(mal_l, by = "ligand") %>%
  inner_join(tme_r, by = "receptor") %>%
  mutate(concordant = sign(lfc_L) == sign(lfc_R),
         subtype    = ifelse(lfc_L > 0, "Subtype_1", "Subtype_2"),
         any_sig    = p_L < 0.1 | p_R < 0.1)

cat("concordant L-R pairs (same subtype direction), >=1 side padj<0.1:\n")
lr_tab %>% filter(concordant, any_sig) %>%
  transmute(subtype, ligand, receptor, celltype,
            lfc_L = round(lfc_L, 2), p_L = signif(p_L, 2),
            lfc_R = round(lfc_R, 2), p_R = signif(p_R, 2)) %>%
  arrange(subtype, desc(abs(lfc_L) + abs(lfc_R))) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

lim <- max(abs(c(lr_tab$lfc_L, lr_tab$lfc_R)), na.rm = TRUE)
lab <- lr_tab %>% filter(concordant, any_sig) %>%
  mutate(s = abs(lfc_L) + abs(lfc_R)) %>% slice_max(s, n = 18)
ggplot(lr_tab, aes(lfc_L, lfc_R)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(concordant, subtype, "discordant")), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = paste0(ligand, "->", receptor, " (", celltype, ")")),
    size = 2.4, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = "grey75") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Subtype_1 = "#B2182B", Subtype_2 = "#2166AC",
                                discordant = "grey80"), name = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  labs(x = "malignant ligand logFC (S1 vs S2)", y = "TME receptor logFC (S1 vs S2)",
       title = "Concordant malignant ligand -> TME receptor by subtype") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r secretome_dotplots, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 11}
# DotPlots: malignant ligand expression (by subtype) paired with cognate receptor
# expression across TME celltypes, per subtype. Malignant cells come from the FULL
# fig1 object (removed from the TME re-subset); TME cells = ctcl.
if (!exists("obj")) obj <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
mcells <- colnames(obj)[obj$celltype.malig == "CTCL" & obj$Tissue == "skin"]
malig  <- obj[, mcells]
malig$subtype <- base::unname(orig_to_subtype[as.character(malig$orig.merge)])
malig  <- malig[, malig$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")]
malig$subtype <- factor(as.character(malig$subtype), levels = c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2"))
malig  <- NormalizeData(malig, verbose = FALSE)

ctcl$subtype <- factor(as.character(ctcl$subtype), levels = c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2", "ND"))
ctcl_s1 <- ctcl[, ctcl$subtype == "Subtype_1"]
ctcl_s2 <- ctcl[, ctcl$subtype == "Subtype_2"]

present <- function(o, f) f[f %in% rownames(o)]
# S1: ligand -> receptor;  S2: ligand -> receptor
s1_lig <- c("CSF2", "XCL1", "IFNG");        s1_rec <- c("CSF2RA", "XCR1", "IFNGR1")
s2_lig <- c("CXCL13", "CXCL10", "LGALS9");  s2_rec <- c("CXCR5", "CXCR3", "HAVCR2")

dp <- function(o, feats, grp, ttl)
  DotPlot(o, features = present(o, feats), group.by = grp) +
    Seurat::RotatedAxis() + ggtitle(ttl) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.title = element_blank())

d1 <- dp(malig,   s1_lig, "subtype",          "S1 ligands - malignant")
d2 <- dp(ctcl_s1, s1_rec, "celltype.unified", "S1 receptors - TME (Subtype_1)")
d3 <- dp(malig,   s2_lig, "subtype",          "S2 ligands - malignant")
d4 <- dp(ctcl_s2, s2_rec, "celltype.unified", "S2 receptors - TME (Subtype_2)")

((d1 | d2) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 3))) /
((d3 | d4) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 3)))
```

```{r tme_receptor_celltype_dotplot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 8}
# all 6 receptor genes across every TME celltype; each celltype's two subtypes are
# adjacent rows (S1 then S2). raw avg expression; specificity via dot size.
recs   <- c("CSF2RA", "XCR1", "IFNGR1", "CXCR5", "CXCR3", "HAVCR2")
expr_d <- GetAssayData(ctcl, "data", assay = "RNA")
md_t   <- ctcl@meta.data
recs   <- recs[recs %in% rownames(expr_d)]

cells_k <- rownames(md_t)[md_t$subtype %in% c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")]
em   <- as.matrix(t(expr_d[recs, cells_k, drop = FALSE]))   # cells x genes
long <- tibble::tibble(celltype = as.character(md_t[cells_k, "celltype.unified"]),
                       subtype  = as.character(md_t[cells_k, "subtype"])) %>%
  bind_cols(as.data.frame(em)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(tidyr::all_of(recs), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr")

summ <- long %>% group_by(gene, celltype, subtype) %>%
  summarise(pct = 100 * mean(expr > 0), avg = mean(expr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(gene    = factor(gene, levels = recs),
         subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")))

# interleave: each celltype's S1 then S2 adjacent (celltypes alphabetical, top->bottom)
ct_order <- sort(unique(summ$celltype))
lev <- as.vector(t(outer(ct_order, levels(summ$subtype), paste, sep = " | ")))
summ$ct_sub <- factor(paste(summ$celltype, summ$subtype, sep = " | "), levels = rev(lev))
ycol <- ifelse(grepl("Subtype_1$", levels(summ$ct_sub)), "#B2182B", "#2166AC")

ggplot(summ, aes(gene, ct_sub, size = pct, color = avg)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_size(range = c(0, 7), name = "% expressing") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "lightgrey", high = "blue", name = "avg expression") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "TME receptor expression per celltype x subtype (S1 red / S2 blue)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = ycol))
```
